title: KnowBias: Mitigating Social Bias in LLMs via Know-Bias Neuron Enhancement

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using standard social bias benchmarks (BBQ, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet) by measuring probability-based bias scores via token-level likelihoods and question-answering accuracy in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts.
